incident: A GitHub production-readback run returned green for a Supabase-only change while the database migration had not yet been applied; terminal closure then marked the obligation FULFILLED.
root_cause: The generic production readback only modeled Netlify deployment applicability and terminal closure did not independently verify the authoritative Supabase migration ledger.
prevention_rule: For every merge containing supabase/migrations/**, derive exact version+name identities from the merge diff and require the Supabase Edge terminal authority to read all identities from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations before FULFILLED or LIVE_BEWEZEN.
